## Progress

- Merged [PR #9](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/9): OpenTelemetry with allowlist scrubbing of spans and logs; test simulates PHI logging and is mutation-checked
- Left: Application Insights dashboards and the 5xx alert (needs Azure, MDV-P0-006)

## Description

OpenTelemetry tracing/metrics/logs → Application Insights. A telemetry processor drops request/response bodies, query strings, auth headers, blob URLs and any field marked sensitive by the classification attribute. Structured logging with message templates only (no string-concatenated values of classified fields). Front-end error reporting strips URLs with ids and never sends form values.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A test request containing a synthetic patient name, phone and Emirates ID produces telemetry in which none of those values appear (automated log scan in integration tests).
- [ ] **AC2.** Request bodies and query strings are never exported; correlation ids are.
- [ ] **AC3.** Dashboards show request rate, p95 latency, error rate and dependency failures for staging.
- [ ] **AC4.** An alert fires on 5xx rate > 2 % over 5 minutes in staging/prod.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
